head: Font Shelf installs fonts you own on your iPhone and iPad
dek: Font Shelf imports TrueType and OpenType fonts, even whole zip files, groups them by family and prepares a profile so iOS can install them. It was #40 among paid Graphics & Design apps on the US App Store on 11 November.
details: iOS asks you to review and confirm the profile before the fonts are installed. It costs $0.99 with no in-app purchases, by Marcos Romero Lamas, and needs iOS 17.
means: Fonts you bought can be used in apps like Pages or Keynote on your phone.
todo: Find Font Shelf in the App Store, then confirm the profile in Settings.
